turn into: The caterpillar will turn into a beautiful butterfly in a few weeks.
毛毛虫几周后会变成一只美丽的蝴蝶。
once upon: Once upon a time, there lived a kind old man in a small village.
从前，在一个小村庄里住着一位善良的老人。
fall in love: They fell in love with each other during their first year at college.
他们在大学一年级时相爱了。
get married: My parents got married thirty years ago and still live happily together.
我父母三十年前结婚，至今仍幸福地生活在一起。
feel free: Feel free to ask me any questions if you don't understand the lesson.
如果你不懂这节课的内容，尽管问我任何问题。
as far as I know: As far as I know, the meeting has been put off until next Friday.
就我所知，会议已推迟到下周五。
take in: Plants take in carbon dioxide from the air to make their own food.
植物从空气中吸收二氧化碳来制造养分。
in the face of: He remained calm in the face of danger and helped everyone escape safely.
面对危险他保持镇定，帮助所有人安全逃离。
even though: Even though it was raining hard, the workers continued to build the bridge.
尽管雨下得很大，工人们仍继续修建大桥。
the Pacific Ocean: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean in the world.
太平洋是世界上最大、最深的海洋。
at birth: A baby panda weighs only about one hundred grams at birth.
熊猫幼崽出生时体重仅约一百克。
up to: The bus can hold up to forty passengers at a time.
这辆公交车一次最多能载四十名乘客。
walk into: She walked into the room quietly so as not to wake the baby.
她悄悄地走进房间，以免吵醒宝宝。
fall over: Be careful on the icy road, or you might fall over.
在结冰的路上要小心，否则你可能会摔倒。
or so: The trip to the museum will take two hours or so by bus.
坐公交车去博物馆大约需要两个小时。
full of: The children's room was full of toys and picture books.
孩子们的房间里满是玩具和图画书。
science fiction: I enjoy reading science fiction because it is full of amazing ideas.
我喜欢读科幻小说，因为它充满了奇妙的想法。
country music: My grandfather likes listening to country music while drinking tea in the garden.
我爷爷喜欢在花园里一边喝茶一边听乡村音乐。
ever since: He moved to Beijing in 2015 and has lived there ever since.
他2015年搬到北京，从那以后就一直住在那里。
one another: The students in our class often help one another with their homework.
我们班的学生经常在作业上互相帮助。
amusement park: We spent the whole day at the amusement park and rode the roller coaster twice.
我们在游乐场玩了一整天，还坐了两次过山车。
tea art: We watched a wonderful tea art performance and learned how to make tea.
我们观看了一场精彩的茶艺表演，学习了如何泡茶。
tea set: My grandmother keeps a beautiful tea set on the shelf in the living room.
我奶奶在客厅的架子上摆着一套漂亮的茶具。
a couple of: I need a couple of days to finish reading this interesting book.
我需要两三天时间读完这本有趣的书。
thousands of: Thousands of tourists come to this small town to enjoy the beautiful scenery every summer.
每年夏天都有成千上万的游客来这个小镇欣赏美景。
all year around: The weather here is warm all year around, so many people come in winter too.
这里全年气候温暖，所以冬天也有很多人来。
yard sale: We held a yard sale last weekend and sold most of our old things.
上周末我们办了一场庭院拍卖会，卖掉了大部分旧物。
bread maker: My mother bought a new bread maker and makes fresh bread every morning.
我妈妈买了一台新的面包机，每天早上都做新鲜面包。
soft toy: The little girl sleeps with her favorite soft toy every night.
小女孩每晚都抱着她最喜欢的布绒玩具睡觉。
check out: You can check out five books at a time from the school library.
你可以一次从学校图书馆借五本书。
board game: On rainy days, we usually play a board game together at home.
下雨天，我们通常在家一起玩棋类游戏。
junior high school: My cousin studied hard in junior high school and entered a good senior high.
我表哥初中学得很努力，考上了一所不错的高中。
clear out: We spent the whole morning clearing out the old boxes in the garage.
我们花了整个上午清理车库里的旧箱子。
no longer: My grandfather no longer drives at night because his eyesight is getting worse.
我爷爷晚上不再开车了，因为他的视力越来越差。
part with: She couldn't part with her old bicycle, though she had used it for ten years.
虽然那辆旧自行车她已经用了十年，但她还是舍不得放弃。
as for: As for me, I would rather stay at home and read on weekends.
至于我，周末宁愿待在家里看书。
to be honest: To be honest, I don't really like the food in that restaurant.
说实在的，我不太喜欢那家餐厅的菜。
close to: The cost of the new library came close to two million yuan.
新图书馆的花费接近两百万元。
play chess: My brother often plays chess with his classmates after school.
我哥哥放学后经常和同学下国际象棋。
speak English: It is important to speak English as much as possible in class.
在课堂上尽可能多说英语很重要。
